name: sii-style-teacher-generate-8gpu
description: SII-style self-teacher phase A over the full multiselect train+dev (30,793 rows): 8 vLLM replicas sample 2 Qwen3.5-4B thinking chains per row with stop='</think>' and a 1024-token cap, then merge reasoning JSONL. No readout in this job; run phase B after it. Resumable per (id, chain). Writes runs/qz/sii_style_teacher/reasoning. CreateJob dry-run first; this payload is not submitted by the harness author.
command:
set -uo pipefail
R=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
cd "$R"
mkdir -p "$R/logs/qz" "$R/runs/qz/sii_style_teacher"
REASONING=1 READOUT=0 SHARDS=8 SAMPLES=2 MAX_TOKENS=1024 MAX_MODEL_LEN=8192 REASONING_BATCH=32 MAX_NUM_SEQS=128 GPU_MEM_UTIL=0.9 DATA_DIR="$R/data/multiselect" RUN_ROOT="$R/runs/qz/sii_style_teacher" LOG_DIR="$R/logs/qz" bash harness/run_sii_style_teacher.sh > "$R/logs/qz/sii_style_teacher_generate.log" 2>&1
status=$?
echo "JOB EXIT=$status"
exit $status
